title: An unclosed <h1> swallows the rest of the document
acceptance: An unclosed heading tag does not absorb subsequent elements as descendants
A page with an unclosed <h1> still extracts its prose
notes: Bonus finding from T-0006, hit while authoring malformed_nesting.html. HTMLParser's implicit-closing table has no heading entry, so an unclosed <h1> takes every following element as a descendant. Combined with the polish step that drops a leading heading repeating the title, this zeroed out an entire page. The agent kept its fixture's <h1> closed so the fixture tests what it is named for, and documented this separately rather than silently encoding it.

history.detail: extractor edge case; malformed markup is rare
